_comment: AUTHORED. The stale-card caveat surface. Three enabled cards against the frozen clock 2026-04-15T12:00:00Z: one never fetched, one 40 days behind, one fetched an hour ago. UserProviderRepo.stale_cards orders never-fetched first then oldest first, so this scenario pins that ordering as well as the membership — every client truncates the list, so the order is part of the contract. The fresh card is here so newest_fetched_at is a real MAX over a mixed set rather than a single value, which is the case where one fresh card can speak for stale siblings.
name: stale-cards
